updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Scanner Data Export for Custom Reporting
updates.summary: The information protection scanner now stores labeling, classification, and protection actions in SQL tables, enabling admins to build custom reports on scanned repository states. This gives compliance officers deeper visibility into data classification effectiveness across their organization.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Legacy Teams Retention Policies Scoped Away from Copilot
updates.summary: Existing retention policies targeting Teams will be converted to Teams-only policies and will no longer implicitly govern Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions. Admins should review retention policies to ensure Copilot governance is explicitly configured if needed.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Protection for Excluded Windows Folders
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP is expanding to monitor sensitive data in commonly excluded Windows directories such as Temp and AppData, closing a coverage gap that previously allowed sensitive files to persist outside DLP oversight. This improves data protection posture by detecting threats in locations often overlooked by standard policies.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Communication Compliance – Enhanced Policy Conditions
updates.summary: Communication Compliance policies gain three new capabilities: detection of external email exchanges, OR logic to combine multiple conditions, and a condition testing tool before deployment. These enhancements let compliance officers build more sophisticated and flexible communication monitoring rules.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Unified Classification Management Experience
updates.summary: A single console now consolidates all classifiers in Purview—Sensitive Information Types, Exact Data Match, fingerprint SITs, and trainable classifiers—enabling admins to discover, validate, and manage classification logic from one place. This streamlines governance of data classification strategy across the organization.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Hard Delete Capability for OneDrive and SharePoint via Secure Priority Cleanup
updates.summary: Data Lifecycle Management is introducing hard delete functionality for OneDrive and SharePoint content through secure priority cleanup workflows, allowing compliance admins to permanently remove data beyond the standard 93-day recycle bin retention. This gives organizations tighter control over permanent data removal for sensitive compliance scenarios.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Now Monitors FTP and SFTP Transfers
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP has reached general availability for monitoring sensitive data transferred over FTP and SFTP protocols, allowing admins to enforce DLP restrictions on file-transfer activities beyond standard cloud and web channels. This closes a compliance gap for organizations using legacy file-transfer protocols.
